Machine Learning Engineer
Brightwater Analytics
Denver, CO

Brightwater Analytics helps utilities forecast demand. Our ML team trains models on smart-meter data and ships them to production with Python and Airflow.

You will work closely with data engineers to turn research notebooks into reliable pipelines, and you will help us decide which models are worth running.

Nice to have
- PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Spark
- Experience with time series forecasting
- dbt

We offer a hybrid schedule, two days in the office.
